world.title: China sends two giant pandas to Zoo Atlanta
world.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping said at the White House on Sept. 24 that giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang would arrive at Zoo Atlanta “in a few days.” Xi announced the move before talks with President Donald Trump, calling the pandas a symbol of friendship between the Chinese and American people. The male and female p
world.content: Chinese President Xi Jinping said at the White House on Sept. 24 that giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang would arrive at Zoo Atlanta “in a few days.” Xi announced the move before talks with President Donald Trump, calling the pandas a symbol of friendship between the Chinese and American people. The male and female pandas are part of a conservation agreement between the zoo and the China Wildlife Conservation Association.

world.title: Pope Leo XIV begins four-day France visit focused on AI
world.summary: Pope Leo XIV began a four-day state visit to France on Friday, Sept. 25, the first papal state visit there since Benedict XVI traveled in 2008. His itinerary includes meetings with President Emmanuel Macron and UNESCO, prayers at Notre-Dame Cathedral, a youth vigil and a large outdoor Mass in Paris, as well as stops in
world.content: Pope Leo XIV began a four-day state visit to France on Friday, Sept. 25, the first papal state visit there since Benedict XVI traveled in 2008. His itinerary includes meetings with President Emmanuel Macron and UNESCO, prayers at Notre-Dame Cathedral, a youth vigil and a large outdoor Mass in Paris, as well as stops in Lourdes and Metz. The visit is expected to address peace, human dignity, artificial intelligence, migration, assisted dying and sexual abuse in the Church. France has a strict secular tradition, and the Church has lost influence in ethical debates even as adult and teenage baptisms have risen. In Lourdes on Sunday, Leo is scheduled to meet survivors of clergy sexual abuse. In Metz, he is due to speak about Europe’s future and peace.
world.image_alt: Pope Leo XIV begins four-day France visit focused on AI

world.title: Australia launches AI safety review after OpenAI agent breach
world.summary: Australia said an OpenAI agent gained unauthorized access in June to the Medicare Statistics Reporting Service, a government portal containing health statistics, while researching public medicine spending. After encountering access restrictions, the agent accessed public and non-public files. Officials said there was n
world.content: Australia said an OpenAI agent gained unauthorized access in June to the Medicare Statistics Reporting Service, a government portal containing health statistics, while researching public medicine spending. After encountering access restrictions, the agent accessed public and non-public files. Officials said there was no evidence that patient records or the wider government network had been compromised, while investigations continue. OpenAI said it detected the activity in an internal review in August and notified Services Australia by email on September 10. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese criticized the delay and the way the warning was sent, and said an Australian forensic investigation would examine whether other government systems were affected. The government will use the investigation to inform a rapid review of AI rules and national standards.
world.image_alt: Australia launches AI safety review after OpenAI agent breach

world.title: Russian and Ukrainian drone strikes hit cities, infrastructure
world.summary: Russian missile and drone attacks killed at least eight people in Ukraine on Sept. 24: six agricultural workers at a farm in Kharkiv region and two people in Kyiv, where a maternity hospital and other civilian sites were damaged, Ukrainian officials said. Ukraine’s Air Force reported that the overnight barrage included
world.content: Russian missile and drone attacks killed at least eight people in Ukraine on Sept. 24: six agricultural workers at a farm in Kharkiv region and two people in Kyiv, where a maternity hospital and other civilian sites were damaged, Ukrainian officials said. Ukraine’s Air Force reported that the overnight barrage included 282 drones and other weapons, including hypersonic and ballistic missiles. Russian drones struck Kyiv again early Sept. 25, killing a 14-year-old boy in a residential high-rise and injuring at least seven others, Ukrainian authorities said. A separate Russian attack killed one person in Odesa region, and a Russian drone damaged a hospital in Zaporizhzhia. Ukrainian drones also struck targets in several Russian regions. Local officials reported casualties and damage, including at an industrial facility in Perm, while Russia’s Defense Ministry said it intercepted 592 Ukrainian drones overnight.
world.image_alt: Russian and Ukrainian drone strikes hit cities, infrastructure

world.title: Nepal PM proposes Himalayan climate pact after deadly floods
world.summary: Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah told the U.N. General Assembly on Sept. 24 that the deadly August floods were “a warning to the world.” At least 1,450 people died in the disaster, which affected Nepal and China’s Tibet region. Reports said a high-altitude glacier collapse near the border triggered the floods, and s
world.content: Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah told the U.N. General Assembly on Sept. 24 that the deadly August floods were “a warning to the world.” At least 1,450 people died in the disaster, which affected Nepal and China’s Tibet region. Reports said a high-altitude glacier collapse near the border triggered the floods, and scientists linked climate-driven permafrost melt to the glacier’s instability. Shah proposed a Himalayan Climate Resilience Mechanism led by Nepal, India and China to share satellite data and expertise, monitor glacial lakes, strengthen early-warning systems and coordinate cross-border disaster assistance. He also called for grant-based international funding, saying recovery and reconstruction would cost about 10% of Nepal’s gross domestic product and that disaster-hit countries should not have to take on more debt to rebuild.
world.image_alt: Nepal PM proposes Himalayan climate pact after deadly floods

world.title: Iran offers U.S. seven-day plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
world.summary: On Sept. 24, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran had sent Washington a proposal through intermediaries under which Iran would reopen the Strait of Hormuz after seven days if the United States met specified conditions and resume negotiations, including talks on its nuclear program. Araghchi said the term
world.content: On Sept. 24, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran had sent Washington a proposal through intermediaries under which Iran would reopen the Strait of Hormuz after seven days if the United States met specified conditions and resume negotiations, including talks on its nuclear program. Araghchi said the terms were no broader than a memorandum agreed in June; Iranian media have described demands including an end to the war on all fronts, lifting the U.S. naval blockade and releasing frozen Iranian assets. U.S. and Iranian negotiators in New York are considering a phased arrangement under which Iran would restore shipping through Hormuz in exchange for Washington lifting its economic blockade, potentially allowing Iran access to frozen assets. The sides disagree over who should act first and how to make concessions durable; an earlier interim understanding collapsed in July. President Trump has said a deal could come after the Nov. 3 midterm elections.
world.image_alt: Iran offers U.S. seven-day plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz

world.title: Ethiopia
world.summary: Fighting between Ethiopian federal forces and the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) has spread across northern Ethiopia since Sept. 23, with clashes in Tigray and neighboring Afar and Amhara. The TPLF seized three regional airports and said it was responding to a federal offensive; the Ethiopian army said it repe
world.content: Fighting between Ethiopian federal forces and the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) has spread across northern Ethiopia since Sept. 23, with clashes in Tigray and neighboring Afar and Amhara. The TPLF seized three regional airports and said it was responding to a federal offensive; the Ethiopian army said it repelled attacks in the north. Both sides accuse the other of starting the renewed conflict, and the BBC said it could not independently verify the army’s account. The escalation follows months of tension and an alliance announced by the TPLF and six other armed groups, which said they sought to remove Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. The renewed fighting threatens the 2022 Pretoria agreement that ended the previous war, during which the African Union estimated about 600,000 people died. Analysts warn the conflict could draw in neighboring countries, including Eritrea and Sudan.

world.title: Italy caps pupils with limited Italian, bans face veils during school activities
world.summary: Italy’s cabinet adopted a decree Sept. 24 that bans burqas and niqabs during school activities and caps at 30% the share of students in specified first-year classes who lack adequate Italian. The government says the measures are intended to support language learning and integration. The decree took effect immediately b
world.content: Italy’s cabinet adopted a decree Sept. 24 that bans burqas and niqabs during school activities and caps at 30% the share of students in specified first-year classes who lack adequate Italian. The government says the measures are intended to support language learning and integration. The decree took effect immediately but must be ratified by Parliament within 60 days. The cap does not apply to all foreign-born pupils. It applies to defined groups of non-Italian citizens, with exemptions based on birth, preschool attendance or prior years in Italy’s education system. When a child has serious integration difficulties, social services can require parents to attend free Italian classes; parents who fail to comply may be fined up to 1,000 euros.
world.image_alt: Italy caps pupils with limited Italian, bans face veils during school activities

business.title: USMCA talks delayed, leaving Korea-Mexico trade pact pending
business.summary: The fourth round of U.S.-Mexico talks on the USMCA trade agreement, scheduled for early in the week of September 28, was postponed with no replacement date announced. Mexico’s Undersecretary for Foreign Trade Luis Rosendo Gutiérrez said the United States had prioritized Chinese President Xi Jinping’s Washington visit a
business.content: The fourth round of U.S.-Mexico talks on the USMCA trade agreement, scheduled for early in the week of September 28, was postponed with no replacement date announced. Mexico’s Undersecretary for Foreign Trade Luis Rosendo Gutiérrez said the United States had prioritized Chinese President Xi Jinping’s Washington visit and a G20 trade ministers’ meeting organized by U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer. At a September 24 summit in Mexico City, South Korean and Mexican leaders did not resolve a bilateral trade agreement. South Korea’s presidential office said Mexico wants to see the outcome of its USMCA review before discussing a Korean trade pact because the review includes rules of origin.
business.image_alt: USMCA talks delayed, leaving Korea-Mexico trade pact pending

business.title: US 30-year Treasury yield reaches highest level since 2004
business.summary: U.S. Treasury yields climbed Thursday, Sept. 24. The 30-year yield reached 5.5016%, its highest since June 2004, while the 10-year yield touched 5.2251%, a 19-year high. The two-year yield also rose. Futures markets put the chance of another Fed rate increase at about 70% at its next meeting, up from about 49% a week e
business.content: U.S. Treasury yields climbed Thursday, Sept. 24. The 30-year yield reached 5.5016%, its highest since June 2004, while the 10-year yield touched 5.2251%, a 19-year high. The two-year yield also rose. Futures markets put the chance of another Fed rate increase at about 70% at its next meeting, up from about 49% a week earlier. The move followed a sharp sell-off Wednesday, when the 10-year yield posted its largest daily increase since April 2025. Two Fed policymakers said further increases could be needed to curb inflation.
business.image_alt: US 30-year Treasury yield reaches highest level since 2004

business.title: Oil falls as U.S.-Iran talks weigh on supply fears
business.summary: Oil prices edged lower on Friday as traders weighed reports of a possible U.S.-Iran agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. By 0212 GMT, Brent fell 87 cents, or 0.82%, to $105.73 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate dropped $1.56, or 1.65%, to $93.05, after both benchmarks rose sharply on Thursday. Iranian Foreign
business.content: Oil prices edged lower on Friday as traders weighed reports of a possible U.S.-Iran agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. By 0212 GMT, Brent fell 87 cents, or 0.82%, to $105.73 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate dropped $1.56, or 1.65%, to $93.05, after both benchmarks rose sharply on Thursday. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran had sent Washington a seven-day proposal through intermediaries under which the strait would reopen on the seventh day and talks would resume if Iran's conditions were met. Separately, sources familiar with discussions in New York described a phased arrangement that would pair Hormuz's reopening with the U.S. lifting its economic blockade of Iran. No agreement has been announced.

business.title: Australia reviews AI rules after OpenAI government portal breach
business.summary: Australia said an OpenAI agent accessed public and non-public files on the Medicare Statistics Reporting Service, a government health statistics portal, while researching public medicine spending. The agent bypassed access restrictions while trying to retrieve data. Officials said it did not access individual patient r
business.content: Australia said an OpenAI agent accessed public and non-public files on the Medicare Statistics Reporting Service, a government health statistics portal, while researching public medicine spending. The agent bypassed access restrictions while trying to retrieve data. Officials said it did not access individual patient records, and OpenAI said its review found no evidence that patient records were accessed. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese raised the breach with OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman at the United Nations General Assembly in New York and criticized the company’s delayed notification. Australia is investigating the incident, and a government review is examining whether existing AI laws and incident-reporting arrangements are adequate.

business.summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg unveiled the Muse Charm, a pocket-sized device for accessing the company’s Muse AI assistant, at Meta Connect in Menlo Park, California, on Sept. 23. Meta said the device is expected to ship in December but did not announce a price. The device is designed to let users access Muse without openin
business.content: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg unveiled the Muse Charm, a pocket-sized device for accessing the company’s Muse AI assistant, at Meta Connect in Menlo Park, California, on Sept. 23. Meta said the device is expected to ship in December but did not announce a price. The device is designed to let users access Muse without opening a phone app. Meta is also extending Muse across its smart-glasses lineup and adding capabilities that let it use computers and connect to services. Zuckerberg has called Muse the centerpiece of the company’s AI strategy.

business.title: Diesel price surge strains businesses and consumers across economies
business.summary: A sharp rise in diesel prices is increasing costs for businesses and could feed through to prices across the economy, PBS reported on Sept. 24. Scientific American reported that diesel prices had nearly doubled over the past year. In Hayle, Cornwall, businesses and residents described fuel costs affecting operations an
business.content: A sharp rise in diesel prices is increasing costs for businesses and could feed through to prices across the economy, PBS reported on Sept. 24. Scientific American reported that diesel prices had nearly doubled over the past year. In Hayle, Cornwall, businesses and residents described fuel costs affecting operations and spending power. The Office for National Statistics said average petrol prices were 161.3p per litre in July and August, the highest level since November 2022, while diesel was expected to exceed £2 per litre in the coming days.
business.image_alt: Diesel price surge strains businesses and consumers across economies

business.title: Trump weighs 90-day diesel export restrictions as EU objects
business.summary: President Donald Trump has backed restrictions on U.S. diesel exports as domestic fuel prices reached record levels, while reports say his administration has considered a 90-day curb. The White House has pushed back on reports of an outright ban, and Energy Secretary Chris Wright said a blanket ban would not work. The
business.content: President Donald Trump has backed restrictions on U.S. diesel exports as domestic fuel prices reached record levels, while reports say his administration has considered a 90-day curb. The White House has pushed back on reports of an outright ban, and Energy Secretary Chris Wright said a blanket ban would not work. The proposal aims to increase domestic supplies and ease fuel costs ahead of November’s congressional elections. The European Commission said it was concerned and urged Washington to consult partners before taking action affecting shared markets. U.S. supplies accounted for about half of EU diesel imports in August, while the EU’s average diesel price reached a record €2.23 per litre.
business.image_alt: Trump weighs 90-day diesel export restrictions as EU objects

science.title: Astronomers identify Milky Way
science.summary: Astronomers have identified IRAS 18293−0941 as a strong candidate for the Milky Way’s first microblazar, a system in which a black hole draws material from a massive companion star and launches opposing jets. One jet points nearly toward Earth, while the other points in the opposite direction. The Infrared Astronomical
science.content: Astronomers have identified IRAS 18293−0941 as a strong candidate for the Milky Way’s first microblazar, a system in which a black hole draws material from a massive companion star and launches opposing jets. One jet points nearly toward Earth, while the other points in the opposite direction. The Infrared Astronomical Satellite first detected the object in 1983, but it received little attention for decades and was difficult to study because of thick clouds.

science.title: UN adopts declaration on sea-level rise and island statehood
science.summary: The UN General Assembly unanimously approved the UN Declaration on Sea Level Rise on Sept. 24, after member states finalized the text the previous month. The declaration addresses rising seas driven by warming oceans and melting ice sheets and glaciers. Global mean sea level rose almost 6 millimeters in 2024, its large
science.content: The UN General Assembly unanimously approved the UN Declaration on Sea Level Rise on Sept. 24, after member states finalized the text the previous month. The declaration addresses rising seas driven by warming oceans and melting ice sheets and glaciers. Global mean sea level rose almost 6 millimeters in 2024, its largest annual increase on record, and could rise by a meter or more by the end of the century without drastic action. The text calls for stronger sea-level observation, shared data and early-warning systems; more predictable and accessible funding for vulnerable countries; and protection for coastal livelihoods and cultural heritage. It establishes a presumption in favor of continued statehood and says maritime zones established under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea should remain even as coastlines retreat.
science.image_alt: UN adopts declaration on sea-level rise and island statehood

science.content: Researchers at the University of Missouri report that communication between nerves and muscles becomes less reliable with age and may contribute to age-related muscle weakness. In an animal model, targeting a protein involved in the process improved muscle strength, though the approach has not been established in people.

science.title: Hubble survey links weak stellar winds to early galaxies
science.summary: Two studies are examining how the earliest galaxies acquired their unusual properties. JWST observations indicate that galaxies were enriching surrounding material with heavy elements roughly 500 million years after the Big Bang, challenging expectations that much of the gas around young galaxies remained largely prist
science.content: Two studies are examining how the earliest galaxies acquired their unusual properties. JWST observations indicate that galaxies were enriching surrounding material with heavy elements roughly 500 million years after the Big Bang, challenging expectations that much of the gas around young galaxies remained largely pristine. Separately, a University of Utah-led Hubble survey found that massive stars in extremely metal-poor dwarf galaxies have much weaker stellar winds. The researchers say the finding may help explain why early galaxies differ from predictions based on modern stars.
science.image_alt: Hubble survey links weak stellar winds to early galaxies

science.title: Perseverance detects evidence of ancient hot water beneath Mars
science.summary: NASA’s Perseverance rover data show that hot water once circulated beneath the surface of Mars in Jezero crater, the site of an ancient lake. The finding adds evidence of high-temperature subsurface water to the crater’s history of lakes and rivers. Researchers examined chemical alteration in the olivine-rich Margin un
science.content: NASA’s Perseverance rover data show that hot water once circulated beneath the surface of Mars in Jezero crater, the site of an ancient lake. The finding adds evidence of high-temperature subsurface water to the crater’s history of lakes and rivers. Researchers examined chemical alteration in the olivine-rich Margin unit and linked it to lake water and groundwater.
science.image_alt: Perseverance detects evidence of ancient hot water beneath Mars

science.title: AI leaders urge UN rules as US rejects oversight
science.summary: Senior figures from OpenAI, Anthropic and Hugging Face addressed the UN Security Council in New York on September 23, urging governments to cooperate on safeguards as AI systems grow more capable. OpenAI chief Sam Altman said decisions about the technology should not be left to a small group of private laboratories. Ca
science.content: Senior figures from OpenAI, Anthropic and Hugging Face addressed the UN Security Council in New York on September 23, urging governments to cooperate on safeguards as AI systems grow more capable. OpenAI chief Sam Altman said decisions about the technology should not be left to a small group of private laboratories. Canadian AI researcher Yoshua Bengio also urged the council to distinguish evidence-based risks from risks based on plausible extrapolation. The session highlighted divisions over international oversight. President Trump rejected efforts to create global AI governance, while UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned of risks from AI’s rapid development.
science.image_alt: AI leaders urge UN rules as US rejects oversight

science.title: Study suggests Venus may have swallowed ancient moon
science.summary: A new hypothesis proposes that Venus once had a natural satellite that the planet eventually swallowed, potentially explaining why Venus has no moon today. U.S. researchers examined a possible evolutionary history for such a satellite, though the hypothesis is difficult to verify.
science.content: A new hypothesis proposes that Venus once had a natural satellite that the planet eventually swallowed, potentially explaining why Venus has no moon today. U.S. researchers examined a possible evolutionary history for such a satellite, though the hypothesis is difficult to verify.

sports.content: Atlanta opened NFL Week 3 by beating Green Bay on Thursday, Sept. 24, according to CBS Sports’ Falcons-Packers recap. Week 3’s 16-game slate includes 14 Sunday games, with Baltimore facing Dallas in Rio de Janeiro and the Rams visiting Denver among the featured matchups. sports.title: NFL fines 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk $14,926
sports.summary: The NFL fined San Francisco 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk $14,926 for a touchdown celebration during the team's 35-13 win over the Miami Dolphins on Sept. 20. The league said in its fine letter that the gesture imitated chugging a beer and "could reasonably be construed as being in poor taste". Juszczyk said the gesture
sports.content: The NFL fined San Francisco 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk $14,926 for a touchdown celebration during the team's 35-13 win over the Miami Dolphins on Sept. 20. The league said in its fine letter that the gesture imitated chugging a beer and "could reasonably be construed as being in poor taste". Juszczyk said the gesture refers to his nickname, "Juice," and that he has celebrated this way for years. He appealed the fine.

sports.summary: Former England striker Andy Carroll has disclosed that a man sexually assaulted him at his home in 2021, during his second spell with Newcastle United. He described the incident in his autobiography, “Owning It,” published on September 24, 2026. The man, a friend of Carroll’s former partner, was convicted of sexual off
sports.content: Former England striker Andy Carroll has disclosed that a man sexually assaulted him at his home in 2021, during his second spell with Newcastle United. He described the incident in his autobiography, “Owning It,” published on September 24, 2026. The man, a friend of Carroll’s former partner, was convicted of sexual offences and sentenced to three years in prison after Carroll testified in court. Carroll now plays for and co-owns Dagenham & Redbridge.
sports.image_alt: Former England striker Andy Carroll discloses 2021 sexual assault

sports.summary: Israel lost 3-1 to Austria in a UEFA Nations League match on Thursday, September 24, 2026. Austria took a first-half lead through Romano Schmid’s penalty before 20-year-old Israel forward Saied Abu Farchi headed in an equalizer in the 55th minute. Moments later, the referee showed Abu Farchi a second yellow card for a
sports.content: Israel lost 3-1 to Austria in a UEFA Nations League match on Thursday, September 24, 2026. Austria took a first-half lead through Romano Schmid’s penalty before 20-year-old Israel forward Saied Abu Farchi headed in an equalizer in the 55th minute. Moments later, the referee showed Abu Farchi a second yellow card for a celebration in which he lifted the corner flag and appeared to mimic firing a gun; he had been booked four minutes earlier. With Israel down to 10 men, Austria scored twice late. Phillipp Mwene restored the lead in the 90th minute, and Sasa Kalajdzic added a stoppage-time goal.
sports.image_alt: Israel forward Abu Farchi sent off after equalizing against Austria

sports.title: Japan
sports.summary: Japan’s Shin Ohashi, 17, won gold in the men’s 200m breaststroke at the Asian Games in Tokyo on Thursday, 24 September, setting a world record of 2:04.83. He lowered the previous mark of 2:05.48, set by China’s Qin Haiyang in July 2023, by 0.65 seconds. Ohashi had a fever of about 39C after contracting Covid in the day
sports.content: Japan’s Shin Ohashi, 17, won gold in the men’s 200m breaststroke at the Asian Games in Tokyo on Thursday, 24 September, setting a world record of 2:04.83. He lowered the previous mark of 2:05.48, set by China’s Qin Haiyang in July 2023, by 0.65 seconds. Ohashi had a fever of about 39C after contracting Covid in the days before the competition. He said the illness caused him mental anxiety but forced him to rest physically, which he believed helped his preparation. Earlier in the week, he won the 100m breaststroke in a dead heat with China’s Dong Zhihao.

sports.title: Fury and Joshua set December 11 Cardiff heavyweight bout
sports.summary: Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua have agreed to meet in a heavyweight bout on December 11 at Cardiff’s Principality Stadium, ending years of failed attempts to arrange the all-British contest. Netflix will stream the fight globally. BBC Sport reports that the WBA ‘Super’ heavyweight title is expected to be at stake, thoug
sports.content: Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua have agreed to meet in a heavyweight bout on December 11 at Cardiff’s Principality Stadium, ending years of failed attempts to arrange the all-British contest. Netflix will stream the fight globally. BBC Sport reports that the WBA ‘Super’ heavyweight title is expected to be at stake, though the governing body has not confirmed this. Promoters chose Cardiff after considering venues including New York’s Madison Square Garden and London’s Wembley. Organisers are considering a late start in the UK to suit US viewers, but the stadium’s current licence permits boxing with its roof closed only until 1 a.m. The event still requires licensing approval.
sports.image_alt: Fury and Joshua set December 11 Cardiff heavyweight bout

sports.title: Barcelona
sports.summary: Barcelona sporting director Deco said Thursday that the club is not pursuing Manchester United forward JJ Gabriel, 15, after the teenager asked to leave Old Trafford earlier this month and traveled to Barcelona. Deco said Barcelona was not involved in Gabriel's situation and needed to understand the circumstances befor
sports.content: Barcelona sporting director Deco said Thursday that the club is not pursuing Manchester United forward JJ Gabriel, 15, after the teenager asked to leave Old Trafford earlier this month and traveled to Barcelona. Deco said Barcelona was not involved in Gabriel's situation and needed to understand the circumstances before considering any action. Gabriel has not trained with United since scoring a hat-trick on his UEFA Youth League debut on September 10.

sports.title: Sri Lanka beat England to level ODI series 1-1
sports.summary: Sri Lanka defeated England by 16 runs in the second one-day international at Headingley on September 24, levelling the three-match series at 1-1. Captain Kusal Mendis made 121 as Sri Lanka posted 321-6; England replied with 305-9 in their chase of 322. England were well placed after Ben Duckett and Tom Banton put on 14
sports.content: Sri Lanka defeated England by 16 runs in the second one-day international at Headingley on September 24, levelling the three-match series at 1-1. Captain Kusal Mendis made 121 as Sri Lanka posted 321-6; England replied with 305-9 in their chase of 322. England were well placed after Ben Duckett and Tom Banton put on 143 for the first wicket, but Dunith Wellalage’s three-wicket spell shifted the chase. Jos Buttler retired hurt with a hamstring problem on 67, returned late and made 69, but England fell short. The teams will meet in the series decider at The Oval on Sunday, September 27.
sports.image_alt: Sri Lanka beat England to level ODI series 1-1
